South Korea Orders Website Blocks on 27 Unregistered Overseas Crypto Exchanges, Including KuCoin, MEXC and BingX South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) announced that the country's communications review authority has ordered domestic access restrictions on 27 unregistered overseas cryptocurrency exchange websites, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex, XT com, Bitrue, CoinW, Poloniex, BTCC, BingX and BitMart, according to Etoday. PANews, October 13 – According to South Korean media outlet Etoday, the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) stated that the relevant review body has decided to block access to or terminate services for the websites of 27 unregistered virtual asset service providers within South Korea, including KuCoin, MEXC, BingX, Phemex, and BitMart. Previous restrictions already covered the download, installation, and updates of their apps, and this move now extends to their websites. The FIU has reported 44 unregistered operators to investigative authorities and will continue to block alternative URLs.
Authorities said the restrictions are aimed at unregistered exchanges and have acknowledged that customers could have difficulty withdrawing assets.
